prompt: Implement ParseLsof in portlist.go. Input is raw output of `lsof -nP -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -F pcn` (field format: lines starting with 'p'=pid, 'c'=command, 'n'=name like '*:3000', '127.0.0.1:8080', '[::1]:5432'). One pid/command block can have many n lines. Return []Listener{PID int, Command string, Port int, Addr string} in input order; Addr is the host part ('*', '127.0.0.1', '::1' — strip brackets), Port the numeric port. Skip malformed n lines and n lines without a port. Dedupe exact (PID,Addr,Port) repeats. Run go test ./... to check.
